assumptions: 总体设计范围 stated as 11.4 km² (proposal section 7.2 and visual/index.html 三层范围); provisional until the official redline is confirmed.
统筹研究范围 stated as 43.6 km² (visual/index.html 三层范围 card); provisional pending official scope confirmation.
Sum of the three announced key detailed design areas: 众智园 192.1 ha + 原点社区 104.3 ha + 大钟寺 72.0 ha (proposal sections 2.3-2.5).
约192.1公顷 stated in proposal section 2.3 for 众智·进化园 (PROV-KEY-001); provisional.
约104.3公顷 stated in proposal section 2.4 for 原点·共生坊 (PROV-KEY-002); provisional.
约72.0公顷 stated in proposal section 2.5 for 星桥·对话港 (PROV-KEY-003, 大钟寺片区); provisional.
Three required key detailed design areas per official announcement 1.5.3: 众智园AI自主创新加速区、北京AI原点社区、大钟寺AI产业聚集区.

land_use_types_count.formula: count(land use types listed in proposal section 8.1)
assumptions: Six MNR-coded land use types in section 8.1: 0802 科研设计用地, 09 商业服务业用地, 07 居住用地, 14 绿地与开敞空间, 12 道路与交通设施, 08 公共管理与公共服务; percentage shares are conceptual pending official controls.
Conceptual green/open-space share of 22% (land use code 14, proposal section 8.1); pending official planning controls and geometry recalculation.
Conceptual public space ratio of 0.15 per design intent; pending official planning controls and geometry recalculation.

ai_service_circle_count.formula: count(15-minute AI service circles planned in proposal section 7.2)
assumptions: 9 AI service circles within the overall design area (11.4 km²), each at ~1.2 km walk radius (proposal section 7.2).

ai_scenario_count.formula: count(scenario cards SC-01..SC-10 in proposal section 3.2)
assumptions: Ten AI scenario cards SC-01 to SC-10 (proposal section 3.2); each follows the service-object/space/data/privacy/human-review/operator framework.

ai_health_station_count.formula: 1 × ai_service_circle_count (one AI health station per service circle)
assumptions: One AI health station (20-50 m²) per service circle, 9 total (proposal section 7.2).

ai_education_pod_count.formula: 1 × ai_service_circle_count (one AI education pod per service circle)
assumptions: One AI education pod (30-60 m²) per service circle, 9 total (proposal section 7.2).

ai_legal_corner_count.formula: 1 × ai_service_circle_count (one AI legal corner per service circle)
assumptions: One AI legal corner (10-20 m²) per service circle, 9 total (proposal section 7.2).

robot_delivery_locker_count.formula: 2 × ai_service_circle_count (two robot delivery lockers per service circle)
assumptions: Two robot delivery lockers per service circle, 18 total (proposal section 7.2).

ai_concierge_terminal_count.formula: 3 × ai_service_circle_count (three AI concierge terminals per service circle)
assumptions: Three AI concierge (AI服务生) voice-interactive terminals per service circle, 27 total (proposal section 7.2); plus terminals along the heritage park every 500 m (proposal section 4.1).
Three AI pilgrimage landmarks: 星桥天线塔、双螺旋步道、人字形记忆广场 (proposal section 4.3).
Three phases: 星桥·启航 (1-2y), 星桥·织网 (3-5y), 星桥·共鸣 (5-10y) (proposal section 9.1).

global_case_study_count.formula: count(case studies listed in proposal section 2.1)
assumptions: Eight global AI/tech ecosystem cases compared and transcended (proposal section 2.1): Stanford Research Park, Kendall Square, 深圳南山, King's Cross, one-north, 涩谷Stream Hall, Silicon Allee, Digital Media City.
Five user personas (proposal section 3.1): 开源开发者、AI初创团队、周边老年居民、国际访客、高校师生.

industry_test_scenario_count.formula: count(test scenarios listed in proposal section 3.3)
assumptions: Three AI industry test & validation scenarios (proposal section 3.3): 自动驾驶接驳环线、低空无人机配送走廊、城市智能体沙盒推演.
Three transit stations with integrated design (proposal section 6.3): 五道口站「创新者门户」、清华东路西口「校-园缝合器」、大钟寺站「星际接口」.

proposed_track_count.formula: count(transit track/rail integration nodes addressed under 1.5.2.3 交通轨道市政配套设施)
assumptions: Three proposed transit track/rail alignment integration nodes are addressed via the station integration proposals (proposal section 6.3); official planned line count pending confirmation.
